description: Rug Radar verdict for a token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: a grade (CLEAN, MID, SKETCHY, RUGGY), a one-liner, a short take and a shareable card, built from real onchain facts: the 0-100 risk score with its reasons and the deployer's record (did their earlier tokens lose liquidity?). Same call shape as quest verdicts: POST tokenAddress with an optional requestKey, echoed back. Rules-based, not financial advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Chain; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

requestKey.description: Optional caller-chosen id, echoed back in the response

name: token_verdict
